description: JavaScript runtimes (node, deno, bun, tsx, ts-node): inline code, scripts, and version checks.

rules.note: Code in `-e` or `-p` that reads the environment and prints or sends it.

safe.note: Deno type checks, lint, format, tests, benchmarks, docs, dependency information, coverage reports, and a compiled build. Tests and benchmarks are project code with a check contract, as `npm test`. `deno run`, `deno eval`, and `deno serve` run a program of the project, so they are not here (dev round 3).
A `deno task` for tests, lint, types, format, a build, or a local server, as the package scripts of `npm`. A name with prod, deploy, release, or publish is not safe.
